results.title: General Info
highlights:
On-site parking for cars/trucks is available for $10 (cash only) at Gate 9. Motorcycles can park for $5 (cash only) at Gate 9. Bicycles can park for free at 915 Memorial Avenue. The Big E provides 1,200 handicapped accessible parking spaces at Gate 9 on a first-come, first-served basis. The Gate 9A area is available for drop-off/pick-up of passengers and has a large canvas tent with benches for patrons.
...

...

The Eastern States Exposition sits at 1305 Memorial Avenue in West Springfield, Massachusetts. The fairgrounds are accessible by car from Interstate 91. On-site parking at Gate 9 costs $10 for cars and trucks (cash only) and $5 for motorcycles. Free bicycle parking is available at 915 Memorial Avenue. During peak weekend days, traffic on Memorial Avenue can back up significantly. Arriving before 9:30 a.m. on weekends is the most reliable way to find parking and get settled before the crowds build.
...
Adult admission at the gate costs $20. Children ages 6 to 12 pay $15. Children under 6 enter free. Parking for cars and trucks is $10 at Gate 9 and must be paid in cash. Grandstand concert tickets are sold separately and are not included with general fair admission.

results.title: Big E Parking & Getting There 2026
highlights: Parking is paid. There's a flat fee per vehicle (check the Big E website for current pricing). Cash speeds things up at the lots, though many now accept cards.

results.title: Getting Here
highlights: Parking: Year-round event parking is $5 (cash only) for non-Fair shows held at Eastern States Exposition. Learn more about Fairtime parking for all vehicles (including campers) on TheBigE.com.Vehicle and pedestrian traffic is through Gates 1 and Gate 9. There is no pedestrian access at Gates 4 and 5 during non-Fair time. Drop offs and ride shares should proceed to Gate 9.On-street parking on Memorial Avenue and adjacent streets or commercial lots during year-round events is strongly discouraged, as this impacts our neighboring residents and businesses. Thank you for your consideration and cooperation.Accommodations: Greater Springfield offers visitors a choice of options. From downtown high-rise hotels to quaint country inns to snug bed & breakfasts, our accommodations all have one thing in common — a sense of peace and welcome that can only be found here, in the Pioneer Valley. Unpack, relax, we’re glad you’ve arrived! Visit Explore Western Mass to help guide you in making reservations for your stay as well as other links that will direct you to area attractions, restaurants and more.
